create.name: Jovinna Chan
create.bio:
Jovinna Chan teaches yoga, conscious dance and ritual, weaving them together with time in nature, poetry and sound. She grew up in a Singapore village surrounded by temples and forest, trained as an actor and dancer in New York, where she also earned a black belt in karate, and in 2007 moved into Kripalu as a resident. Over eight years there she studied with its senior teachers, helped run its yoga teacher trainings at both foundation and advanced levels as assistant dean, and qualified to teach the dance forms Soul Motion and Let Your Yoga Dance. Her wider study has drawn on Taoism and Buddhism as well as yoga philosophy.

She co-founded the Pranotthan School of Yoga and the Shakti Initiation Yoga Leadership School, and with her friend Jurian Hughes created the Dance into Joy programme. She describes herself as a devotee on the path of Self-realisation and is most interested in helping householders, women especially, build their own daily practice; her teaching leans on questions and gentle self-observation rather than fixed answers. Today she leads residential workshops at Kripalu and Esalen, has taught at Omega and 1440 Multiversity, and offers one-to-one mentoring for practitioners and for yoga and dance teachers shaping their own programmes.

courses.title: Dance Into Joy: A Spring Retreat for Body and Soul
courses.description: A weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, co-led with Jurian Hughes, of free-form dance, stillness and reflection set to music. No dance experience is needed, only a willingness to move and let go.

courses.title: The Wild Embrace: A Journey to Vitality
courses.description: A five-day workshop at Esalen in Big Sur, California, on reconnecting with the life force through the body and the land. The week brings together conscious dance, gentle yoga, crystal bowl sound, offerings to the land and quiet time outdoors.

courses.title: Into the Field of Possibility: Ritual and Dance to Set Your Year Free
courses.description: A New Year weekend at Esalen of dance, ritual and sound for closing one year and setting intentions for the next. Participants give thanks, offer blessings and listen to the body for direction, with time in the hot springs between sessions.

courses.title: Mentoring with Jovinna
courses.description: Hour-long one-to-one sessions for people deepening a personal spiritual practice, and for yoga and conscious dance teachers designing their own workshops and finding their voice. Sessions can be booked singly or as a set of four.
courses.price: $175 USD per session; $595 USD for 4 sessions

courses.title: Grounding and Expanding Yoga (Moderate Yoga Video)
courses.description: A home practice video of moderate-level yoga led by Jovinna, sold as a physical DVD or to buy or rent on Vimeo On Demand.

free_resources.title: A Free Gentle Yoga Class with Jovinna
free_resources.description: A full hour of gentle yoga on YouTube, slow-paced and suitable for most levels, led by Jovinna from home.

free_resources.title: Meditation on Love with Jovinna
free_resources.description: A guided meditation of just over half an hour on opening to love, recorded by Jovinna and free to watch.
